label: prop:meson-em-sinh-closed-form
title: Meson EM sinh-channel closed-form $1 + \hbar_q - \hbar_q^2/2 = (3q^2 - 1)/(2q^2)$
html:
Let R be a commutative ring in which 2 is invertible, and let q \in R^\times. Writing the substrate Planck quantum \hbar_q = (q - 1)/q,

  1 + \hbar_q - \hbar_q^2/2
  \;=\;
  1 + \frac{1 - q^{-2}}{2}
  \;=\;
  \frac{3 - q^{-2}}{2}
  \;=\;
  \frac{3 q^2 - 1}{2 q^2}.

What this proposition claims, and what it does not. The displayed chain is an exact identity of rational functions over R, and that is its entire content. It says that two spellings of one quantity agree. It does not identify that quantity with any physical correction, and it must not be cited as though it did.
heading: Proposition
